_about: Sample selection for the Trail Explorer: Hong Kong’s four long-distance trails. Geometry is from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), simplified for display. Not for navigation. To add a route, append a Feature with the same properties.

properties.name: MacLehose Trail
properties.summary: Crosses the New Territories from Sai Kung in the east to Tuen Mun in the west, through eight country parks.
properties.geometry_source: OpenStreetMap route relations, simplified for display

properties.name: Wilson Trail
properties.region: Hong Kong Island to the New Territories
properties.summary: Runs south to north, from Stanley on Hong Kong Island to Nam Chung in the northern New Territories. The line breaks at the harbour, where the mapped route has no walking path.
properties.source: AFCD, Overview of Country Parks and Special Areas
properties.geometry_source: OpenStreetMap route relations, simplified for display

properties.name: Hong Kong Trail
properties.summary: Eight sections across Hong Kong Island, from Victoria Peak in the west to Big Wave Bay in the east. The last section is the Dragon’s Back.
properties.geometry_source: OpenStreetMap route relations, simplified for display

properties.name: Lantau Trail
properties.summary: A loop that starts and ends in Mui Wo, taking in Sunset Peak, Lantau Peak, Tai O and the south coast of Lantau.
properties.geometry_source: OpenStreetMap route relations, simplified for display
